Privacy Policy

This portfolio is operated by Vansh Rastogi, based in Prayagraj, India. For privacy questions, email vanshrastogimvm@gmail.com.

Project enquiries

The contact form collects the name, email, phone, company, project type, timeline and brief you choose to provide, together with your consent to be contacted. These details are used to respond to your enquiry and discuss the project.

Form processing and hosting

Form submissions are sent through FormSubmit to Vansh’s Gmail inbox. FormSubmit and its security checks may process technical information such as IP addresses and browser information under their own policies. The hosting provider may process technical request logs to operate and protect the website. FormSubmit privacy information.

External services

Google Fonts is requested to display website typography and may receive technical request information. Social, email and WhatsApp links take you to services governed by their own privacy policies.

Video references

Camera tutorial thumbnails are loaded from YouTube. Selecting a reference loads a YouTube player using youtube-nocookie.com. YouTube may process technical information and use storage when you interact with its player. Other film players may load media from external hosting services. Google privacy policy.

Cookies, analytics and advertising

Google AdSense advertising and Google Analytics are not currently enabled on this site. Form security services may use cookies or similar technologies.

If AdSense is activated after site approval, Google and its partners may use cookies, device information and similar technologies to serve and measure advertisements, including personalized ads where permitted and consented. Required consent messages and choices will be configured before serving ads. How Google uses advertising cookies and Google ad personalization choices.

Retention and your choices

Enquiry details are kept while needed to respond and manage the project relationship. Contact the email above to request access, correction or deletion of your enquiry information. Please do not submit sensitive personal information in the brief.
